Monday, April 18th, 2022

Hello ! These are the Working Group (WG) Weekly Updates for the week of Apr 11 - 18. Within this post you’ll find what’s been happening lately in and around our many calendar calls. If you feel like you’re missing out, join us in real time during any of our many syncs or check out our YouTube channel archive for hundreds of recorded calls.

Stewards

  • Sprint 32 (Apr 1 - 14) ended and we kicked off Sprint 33 with a Sprint Planning call: here’s the link to our new Sprint board.
  • Currently we have 3 open (funding) votes on our Gardens:
    • cadCAD Community Funding (requesting 54,000 WXDAI).
    • Retroactive Funding for TEC at ETH Denver 2022 (requesting 965 WXDAI).
    • cadCAD Community Funding (requesting 24,800 WXDAI).
  • This week, during our Sprint Retrospective call, the Stewards agreed on taking 2 actions to improve our Commons:
    • To form a WG with the mandate to bring more funds into our treasury.
    • To add expected milestones to our proposal template so that they can be used in the audit.
  • What was on the Stewards’ mind this week?
    • Temperature checks, newsletter, Rewards update, Amsterdam, upcoming TEC presentations (London Business School blockchain week), #CommonsPrize by Commons Stack, Transparency audit, Scholarship ideas to attend conferences.
  • We hosted a Proposal Inverter AMA alongside PrimeDAO.
  • The TEC is going to ETHAmsterdam (and also to the DAOist, Schelling Point, and DevConnect events happening there).
    • If you’ll be in as well, come out and reach out to us: Zep, Juanka, Angela, Chuy, Nuggan, Tamara, Kristofer, Sem, Paolo, Anna-Marie are the Commoners that are going.
  • Our very own Eduardo will be doing a presentation for the TEC at the London Business School blockchain week (Apr 26 - 28).
  • Forum Highlight:
    • Zepti from Transparency presented a financial report, giving us clarity and perspective on our cash inflows and outflows.
    • The Commons Stack is launching the Commons Prize: nominate a community of your choosing and become the next Commons!

Gravity

  • Our 3rd Graviton Training has been moved one week: It will be starting on May 3rd!
    • We’ll upload the study plan to our forum before our training starts.
  • Every Tuesday Leen and Jeremy host a practice session about Deep Democracy and Liberating Structures, respectively. If you missed the last session—which was about Invitations & Check In Wave—here’s its recording.
  • Our weekly book club is currently reading Margaret Wheatley’s Who Do We Choose To Be? Last week, we went over Chapter 5, which is about Perception. We meet every Thursday at 3 PM EST / 9 PM CEST, right after the community call. Here’s the calendar event link to our next meeting.
  • Every Friday, at 17:00 CEST, we have a Psychology and Mental Health Research sync: you’re welcome to join!
  • If you’re in need of help managing a conflict, you can make a request through our typeform.

Soft Gov

  • The cultural streams that we focused on this week are:
      1. Race and gender by Livia, Edy and Chuy
      1. Religion and Ancient Forms of Knowledge by Chuy and Durgadas
      1. Psychology and Mental Health by Juank, Nate and Boonjue
      1. Personal Development by Enti, Nate and Bear
      1. Opensource Culture and Documentation by Vyvy-vi and Zeptimus
  • We’ve also been looking into Ecosystem Health Metrics: how to measure subjective variables that represent the health of the TEC.
  • Check out our Snapshot Water Proposal.

Communitas

  • During our WG sync, we asked everyone a question: what makes you a TEC member? Here are their responses.
  • We’ve been working on advancing and applying the TEC Engagement Figma diagram.
  • Expect an orientation data update next week.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • Our WG’s Weekly Meeting sync is on Mondays at 20:00 CET.
    • Our TEC Orientation call is Thursdays at 19:00 CET.

0mega

  • Nic created an Omega workflows Figma file where we’ve been aggregating, and curating, all the ideas and initiatives we’ve worked on since the creation of 0mega:
    • TE Consilience Library.
    • Onboarding and building complexity tolerance.
    • Dynamic Energy Budget.
    • Process flow → Energy flow ← Creative flow.
    • Workflows.
  • Research has started around dynamic energy budget with the purpose of creating an art and science lab with an innovative economic model that would fund academic research in a truly interdisciplinary way, having both artists and scientists working together to solve complex issues.
  • We hosted sync #2 of the Imaginarium Creative Jam Session: here are the notes we gathered.

Labs

  • Summon Your Own Discord Bot Army event is still live and will be until May 6th.
  • The Proposal Inverter DAO2DAO Models Workshop happens on Wednesdays 9:00 PST / 18:00 CEST
  • If you missed it, here’s a link to a presentation given in 0mega about the Proposal Inverter.
  • Our Dogfooding the Proposal Inverter-Meta Proposal passed!
  • Also, our NumFocus Proposal passed!
  • The Pre-Registration to our TE Fundamentals Course is open.
  • If you can’t get enough TE, below are our office Hours:
    • From Longtail Financial: Tuesdays & Thursdays at 22:00 CEST / 12:00 PST on the LTF Discord server.
    • From BlockScience: Thursdays at 9:00 PST via Zoom call (ask @Mount Manu on Discord for the link).
  • Help us build the TEC Lab! We are looking for proposal contributors. If you’re interested, get in contact with YGG or Tamara.
  • Forum Highlight:
    • We’ve got a lot of events going on every week so we’ve compiled a calendar for you to join us on any of them.

Rewards

Thank you for reading the WG Weekly update from Apr 11 - 18 Check our calendar and join us on a call soon! I’ll see you next week because right now I have to return some video tapes. Goodbye!
